aws/lambda-integration.title: AWS Lambda Integration
aws/lambda-integration.description: The Helios adapter from @heliosjs/aws translates AWS Lambda events into HeliosJS controller calls. It supports API Gateway (v1/v2), ALB, CloudFront, and Lambda Function URLs.

aws/plugins.title: Custom Plugins for AWS Lambda
aws/plugins.description: Plugins extend the Lambda adapter with lifecycle hooks. Use them for logging, metrics, database connections, or any cross-cutting concern.

core-module/error.title: Error Handling
core-module/error.description: HeliosJS provides built-in error classes and a @Catch decorator for structured error handling.

core-module/parameter-decorators.title: Routing & Parameters
core-module/parameter-decorators.description: HeliosJS provides powerful routing with decorators. Every parameter decorator injects data directly into your handler method.

core-module/rate-limiting.title: Rate Limiting
core-module/rate-limiting.description: HeliosJS provides built-in rate limiting via the @RateLimit decorator with multiple strategies.

core-module/validation.title: Validation with DTOs and class-validator
core-module/validation.description: HeliosJS validates request data using DTO classes with class-validator decorators. Validation runs automatically before your handler executes.

grpc/api.title: gRPC Module API Reference
grpc/api.description: This document provides an overview of the API exports from the gRPC module, including classes, decorators, types, and utility functions.

http-module/graph-ql.title: GraphQL Module in Helios
http-module/graph-ql.description: Helios supports GraphQL integration using type-graphql and graphql-yoga packages, providing a decorator-based approach to define GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and subscriptions.

http-module/plugins.title: Custom Plugins
http-module/plugins.description: Plugins hook into the server lifecycle to add reusable functionality like logging, metrics, database connections, or authentication.

http-module/server.title: HTTP Server
http-module/server.description: The @Server decorator configures your HTTP server, and the Helios class starts and manages it.

http-module/server-sent-events.title: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
http-module/server-sent-events.description: SSE pushes real-time updates from server to client over HTTP. Unlike WebSocket, SSE is unidirectional (server → client) and works over standard HTTP.

http-module/websockets.title: WebSocket
http-module/websockets.description: HeliosJS provides decorator-driven WebSocket support with topic pub/sub, broadcasting, and client management.

intro.title: Intro
intro.description: Welcome to HeliosJS! A decorator-first Node.js framework for building REST APIs, WebSocket servers, and serverless functions with TypeScript.

middlewares/basics.title: Middleware Decorators Basics
middlewares/basics.description: This document provides an overview of the middleware decorators available in the HeliosJS framework. Middleware decorators allow you to apply reusable logic such as error handling, CORS configuration, guards, interceptors, pipes, sanitization, and general middleware functions at the controller or method level.

middlewares/catch.title: Catch Middleware Decorator
middlewares/catch.description: The @Catch decorator registers error handlers at the controller or method level.

middlewares/cors.title: Cors Middleware Decorator
middlewares/cors.description: The @Cors decorator configures Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for controllers or methods.

middlewares/fingerprint.title: Fingerprint Decorator
middlewares/fingerprint.description: Request fingerprinting derives a stable identifier from request attributes (client IP, User-Agent, headers), hashes it, and exposes it to your application. HeliosJS provides two complementary decorators:

middlewares/guard.title: Guard Decorator
middlewares/guard.description: The @Guard decorator registers a guard that controls access to a controller or route handler.

middlewares/intercept.title: Intercept Middleware Decorator
middlewares/intercept.description: The @Intercept decorator wraps route handlers with before/after logic.

middlewares/pipe.title: Pipe Middleware Decorator
middlewares/pipe.description: The @Pipe decorator transforms request data before it reaches the handler.

middlewares/roles.title: Roles (RBAC) Decorator
middlewares/roles.description: The @Roles decorator adds role-based access control (RBAC) to controllers and routes. It restricts access to users that hold one or more required roles, building on the same guard pipeline as @Guard.

middlewares/sanitize.title: Sanitize Middleware Decorator
middlewares/sanitize.description: The @Sanitize decorator applies Joi-based sanitization to request data.

middlewares/use.title: Use Middleware Decorator
middlewares/use.description: The @Use decorator registers middleware functions that execute before the route handler.
